scope: Ideal capped experiment A: all 59 statistical slots succeed. Under iid matched N histories and positive monitor availability, P_CAL(r>.05 | A)<=.95**59; calibration-averaged single-look rank error conditional on A and future availability<=1/60. R denotes resource/runtime completion: no claim conditional on A AND R. Only P(A AND R AND bad_bank)<=.95**59 is inherited without additional assumptions. No automatic rerun/topup; no power, source-accuracy, multi-look or composite-null claim.

required_assumptions: independent CAL score streams and an independent future null observation
matching predeclared complete null scoring law and availability/stopping rule
first-available sampling only for the stated single-look availability conditioning
whole-calendar inputs are maxima of matching entire null trajectories, including support stops
bank and score design chosen before CAL; no outcome-based bank selection
scope_limits: not an absolute guarantee for every realized bank
not source calibration, source accuracy, or eta qualification
